items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s about Crow Jim. It’s about a white kid and a black girl in a school...

ctx.x: It was my first book for young readers. It was called Jazz Country. I was very moved to find out that this musician in Honolulu who has his own jazz combo, who is Hawaiian – he read it when he was eleven years old, and apparently it meant something to him. But it’s funny how the culture changes. I’ve had more success in terms of sales and international translations from these books for young readers. One was called The Day They Came to Arrest the Book, about censorship in a library. The last book I wrote, which…
We were talking about Lenny Bruce and those words before, and I meant to mention that article that was on the front page of the Times yesterday, about the word “scrotum.” On the first page . . .
